messages:
harper: hey team :wave: quick one — I'm in my first week and trying to spin up a test VM in the GCP project redwood-sandbox-eu (europe-west3) but get a quota error when creating CPUs. error: 'ZONE_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED'. who should I ping to link a billing account or bump quotas? also trying to assume the AWS cross-account role for dedicated testing and the assume-role call fails with 'Access denied'. i have the role ARN from my onboarding email. any quick checks?

samir: welcome harper! :thumbsup: for GCP quotas we usually need a billing link + quota request. lazy checklist: 1) confirm project is linked to billing 2) file quota request (region + machine type) 3) if urgent we can fast-track. can you paste the exact gcloud command and the AWS assume error?

harper: thanks samir. gcloud command i ran:
```
gcloud compute instances create test-vm --project=redwood-sandbox-eu --zone=europe-west3-b --machine-type=n1-standard-4
```
and the GCP console shows: "Quota limit 'CPUS' exceeded for region europe-west3."
for AWS i did:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Dedicated-Access --role-session-name harper-test
```
and got: "An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole"

matt: hey — @harper welcome! for GCP billing linking reach out to @olivia (people ops) if you don't have the billing invite, but infra can also attach a temporary billing link to unblock you. samir, can infra fast-track a CPU quota to unblock?

olivia: hey! i can confirm we sent the billing invite to your email on day 1. can you check spam? if still missing i'll resend. if you need immediate quota bump, file the infra form and ping infra-setup-bot here.

samir: filing a quick internal request now. infra-setup-bot — please create a quota ticket for project redwood-sandbox-eu: add 16 vCPUs in europe-west3, priority=high, requestor=harper. also check AWS cross-account trust policy — most likely the onboarding group wasn't added to the external ID.

infra-setup-bot: got it. ticket created: INF-8421. ETA 4 hours for quota bump (can be faster). to attach billing: follow https://redwood.internal/infra/quotas-request and include project-id + billing-account-id. for AWS assume-role issue, ensure your IAM user is in the onboarding AWS account and that the trust policy includes arn:aws:iam::ONBOARDING_ACCOUNT:root or your specific role. ping me with the role arn if you want me to check.

harper: awesome thanks all. i found the billing invite in spam — accepted it. also added my IAM user to the onboarding group per infra notes. i'll wait on INF-8421 and try the assume-role again once infra confirms. really appreciate the help :relieved:

matt: welcome again. if quota ETA slips ping me and i'll nudge. once quota + role done, test your end-to-end flow and post any logs here. :rocket:
